text:
nate: heads up — deploybot auto-halted canary promotion for v2.9.1. Integration suite failing on staging. Blocking promotion.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion halted for release v2.9.1 (canary-2026-03-21). Failure groups: integration-tests (timeout + missing artifact). Job: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/7890

sasha: link to failing job, thanks. logs show 404 pulling wheel: https://storage.redwood.example/buckets/artifacts/v2.9.1/wheels/redwood_runtime-2.9.1.whl -> 404

maria: looks like upload to artifact-storage failed during build step. I see this in the build output:
```
 ERROR: upload failed: 403 Forbidden for PUT /buckets/artifacts/...
```

oliver: or it's a cache eviction on the artifact proxy. Bazel remote cache returned MISS for //runtime:wheel so integration tried to build locally and timed out.

sasha: reproducer: `gsutil ls gs://artifacts/v2.9.1/` -> empty

nate: we have a change window at 18:00 UTC. Can we pin canary to last-good image (sha256:abc123def456...) and promote manually, or do we want to fix the artifact upload first?

maria: I can trigger a rebuild+upload now (takes ~12m) and then retrigger promotion. If rebuild works, no rollback needed.

oliver: manual pin sounds safest if rebuild might hit same issue. Pin command (deploybot): `/deploybot pin canary v2.9.0 --reason "artifact upload failure v2.9.1"`

qa-bot: note: if we pin, QA will need to re-run canary smoke (5m) and we should update release notes that v2.9.1 was held for artifact issue.

sasha: +1. Maria — please attempt rebuild. If rebuild fails, we'll pin and promote last-good. Whoever pins, please add a short note for release notes.

maria: starting rebuild now. will report.

deploy-bot: build 7891 queued by maria. Will post status.

maria: build 7891 -> upload ok ✅. `gsutil ls gs://artifacts/v2.9.1/` now shows wheel

deploy-bot: build 7891 succeeded. Retrying canary promotion.

nate: canary promotion retried, watching.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion succeeded. Promotion complete for v2.9.1 :rocket: (promoted at 2026-03-21T17:42:10Z)

sasha: great — no pin needed. I'll add a note to the release notes about transient artifact upload flake and the rebuild step.

nate: thanks all. Follow-up: we'll add a short alert for artifact-storage PUT 403s and a playbook.

oliver: created ticket INFRA-4321 to add alert and playbook.

qa-bot: tagging qa for regression watch: @qa-team

maria: 👍
